DONGYANG WANG was born in Henan, China,
in 1983. He received the bachelor’s degree from
Henan University, in 2006, and the master’s degree
from Shaanxi Normal University, in 2014. From
2007 to 2011, he worked at the New Oriental
School. Since 2019, he has been studying with the
Lyceum of the Philippines University-Batangas.
He has published eight articles. His research inter-
est concentrates on English language studies.
JUNLI SU was born in Henan, China, in 1984. She
received the bachelor’s and master’s degrees from
Henan University, in 2006 and 2009, respectively.
Since 2009, she has been working with the Jiaozuo
Teachers College. She has published more than
15 articles, responsible for four scientiﬁc research
projects. Her research interests mainly focus on
pedagogy and psychology.
HONGBIN YU received the Ph.D. degree in com-
puter science and technology from Shanghai Jiao
Tong University, in 2016, and the M.S. degree in
pattern recognition and intelligent system from the
University of Science and Technology of China,
in 2009. He is currently a Lecturer with the
School of Digital Media, Jiangnan University. His
research interests include brain–computer inter-
face and computer vision.
